title: Maximum Sum Obtained of Any Permutation
summary: Given an array of integers and an array of range requests, find the maximum sum of all requests for any permutation of the array.
statement: Given an array of integers and an array of range requests, find the maximum sum of all requests for any permutation of the array. Each request asks for the sum of a subarray. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Permute nums once, then sum every inclusive requested range.
Maximize the total and return it modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Use a difference array to count how many requests include each index.
Sort those usage counts and nums in the same order.
Pair the largest values with the largest counts.
The rearrangement inequality proves this pairing maximizes the dot product representing the total request sum.
editorial: The rearrangement inequality proves this pairing maximizes the dot product representing the total request sum.
